gui.kineticarmory.predicate.mode.tooltip:
§eClick to toggle logical combinations:
§b[Match ANY] Activates if at least 1 condition is met.
§b[Match ALL] Activates only when ALL conditions are met.
§b[Match MIN X] Activates when met conditions reach X.

§e💡 Advanced: Creating 'Disable Rules' with Inversions
Combine with the [NOT] button for logical inversion!
E.g. If you want: §c"Disable flight when Raining AND in Water"
1. Set Mode to: §b[Match ANY]
2. Add Condition: §a[NOT] Raining
3. Add Condition: §a[NOT] In Water
(De Morgan's Laws: Flight stays active as long as it's NOT raining OR you are NOT in water)
